cd /workspace && for i in 0 1 2 3; do python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(open('examples/checks.json'))
print(d[$i]['input'])" | python3 run.py > /tmp/out$i.json 2>/tmp/err$i.txt; echo "--- case $i exit=$?"; head -c 600 /tmp/out$i.json; echo; cat /tmp/err$i.txt; done
